card_rejected.title: SZÉP Kártya: the portal rejected the card
card_rejected.description:
The OTP portal rejected the balance query with `{reason}`. Balance polling has stopped, so a wrong card code is not retried and the card is not locked.

Check `card_number` (all 16 digits) and `card_code` in your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant.

invalid_config.title: SZÉP Kártya: invalid configuration
invalid_config.description:
The sensor was not set up: {problems}.

Quote both values in `secrets.yaml` (for example `"0123"`), otherwise YAML reads them as numbers and drops leading zeroes. Then restart Home Assistant. The values themselves are not shown here or in the log.
